stageNotes.stage1: Apex https://aagcanada.ca returns 200 with <link rel=canonical href=https://aagcanada.ca/> and <link rel=alternate hreflang=x-default href=https://aagcanada.ca/>. www-fallback also returns 200 with same body. Canonical = apex. Multi-locale alternates exist for /fr/ and /zh/ (sister catalogs, not additional products).
stageNotes.stage2: Heavy 8-batch probe: BATCH 1 headers show cf-ray + server: cloudflare on every request. Burst test 10x200. SQLi/XSS payloads 200. Honeypot paths 404 (Shopify default 404, not WAF block). Bot UA (curl) -> 503; no-UA -> 403 (Cloudflare passive UA-reputation gate). All standard browser UAs return 200. wafType: cloudflare-passive but hasWaf: false (operational — does not block real-browser UAs). hCaptcha + reCAPTCHA scripts present site-wide (Shopify storefront form gating); catalog pages return 200 with product markup -> hasCaptcha: false (not gating crawler).
stageNotes.stage3: Shopify.shop = mh2ua1-6g.myshopify.com + cdn.shopify.com + _shopify_essential cookies. 13 fingerprint markers. adapterType = shopify. needsPlaywright: false (HTML returns full product cards on static fetch; JSON walk also works). verifyMethod: detail-page (per Stage 3 platform->verify table for Shopify; Admin API requires auth).
stageNotes.stage4: Discovery via /collections.json -> 15 collections. 10 firearm-relevant + 5 aggregators. Per-collection JSON walks (firearms, boutique-display-sold, fun-stuff, garment, tactical-gear, bayonet, antique-blank) all return product subsets fully contained in /collections/all (0 missing IDs in cross-check). /collections/all walked at limit=250 across 3 pages = 565 unique IDs. catalogUrls = [/collections/all] (single URL, 100% firearm-relevant coverage proved, minimum URL count).
